description: List the 16 socionics relationship types: name, one-line tagline, category (comfortable, neutral or tense) and the typeza.ai page of each, with the disclaimer to show alongside them. Call it for an overview of how types relate. Duality is the relation for partners and friends; for work, describe pairs as business relations. Typeza describes patterns between types, not what to do.
name: list_relationship_types
title: List relationship types
